Sclerotized_Exoskeleton_Plates.description: A continuous, armor-like cuticle heavily infused with sclerotin proteins and coated in a waxy epicuticle. It provides excellent deflection against physical trauma and completely waterproofs the entity against extreme dehydration.

Noxious_Hemolymph_Cuticle.description: A relatively porous chitin shell harboring pressurized reservoirs of caustic, foul-tasting hemolymph. When the exoskeleton is breached by a predator's bite, it violently reflex-bleeds this noxious fluid directly into their mouth.
